context.body: Divine knowledge does not make asking unnecessary; prayer orders desire around God and neighbors.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Jesus directs disciples to a Father who knows needs, gives a shared prayer, and ties received and extended forgiveness together.
observations.label: Jesus teaches prayer to the Father: action

observations.body: Disciples pray privately and communally for God’s name, kingdom, will, provision, forgiveness, and deliverance.
observations.label: Jesus teaches prayer to the Father: response

observations.body: your Father knows · our Father · your name · your kingdom
observations.label: Words in Matthew 6:5–15

payload.posture: Read Matthew 6:5–15 as jesus names the father evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The passage joins divine forgiveness and human forgiveness without reducing either to a technique for earning the other.
payload.title: Jesus teaches prayer to the Father
